srep-0039-unevenness-varies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<scene version="1.2">
<project width="640" height="360" fps="24" duration="1" background="#000000FF"/>
<output id="still" path="out/frame_%04d.png" codec="png-sequence"/>
<materials><material id="m-clay" baseColor="#FFFFFFFF" metallic="0" roughness="0.6" unevenness="0.8" unevennessScale="16" unevennessSeed="3"/></materials>
<composition>
<object3D id="face" primitive="plane" material="m-clay" width="400" height="300" x="320" y="180"/>
</composition>
<lights><light id="sun" type="directional" yaw="35" pitch="-20" intensity="1"/></lights>
</scene>
